1.w: Therefore, if [there is] any encouragement in Christ, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any inner affections and compassions,

2.w: fulfill my joy so that you⁺ may be of the same mind, having the same love, united in soul, minding the one thing,

3.w: nothing according to self-interest or according to vain conceit, but in humility esteeming one another surpassing yourselves,

4.w: each looking at not the things of yourselves, but each also the things of others.

5.w: Let this mind be in you⁺ that [was] also in Christ Jesus:

6.w: Who, existing in the form of God, did not consider to be equal with God something to be grasped,

7.w: but emptied Himself, having taken the form of a servant, having been made in the likeness of men.

8.w: And having been found in appearance as a man He humbled Himself, having become obedient unto death, even the death of the cross.

9.w: Therefore God also highly exalted Him and granted to Him the name above every name,

10.w: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, in the heavens and on earth and under the earth,

11.w: and every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ [is] Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

12.w: Therefore, my beloved, just as always you⁺ obeyed, not only as in my presence, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.

13.w: For God is the One working in you⁺ both to will and to work on behalf of [His] good pleasure.

14.w: Do all things without grumblings and disputings,

15.w: so that you⁺ may be blameless and innocent, children of God unblemished in the midst of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom you⁺ shine as lights in the world,

16.w: holding forth the word of life for a boast to me in the day of Christ that I did not run in vain, nor did I toil in vain.

17.w: But even if I am being poured out as a drink offering on the sacrifice and service of your⁺ faith, I rejoice and rejoice with you⁺ all.

18.w: And likewise you⁺ also be glad and rejoice with me.

19.w: But I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you⁺ soon, that I also may be of good spirit, having known the things concerning you⁺.

20.w: For I have no one like-minded, who genuinely will care for the things concerning you⁺.

21.w: For those all seek the things of themselves, not the things of Jesus Christ.

22.w: But you⁺ know his proven worth, that as a child [with] a father he served with me in the gospel.

23.w: Therefore indeed I hope to send him immediately, when I shall have seen the things concerning me.

24.w: And I am persuaded in the Lord that I myself will also come soon.

25.w: Now I deemed [it] necessary to send to you⁺ Epaphroditus, my brother and fellow worker and fellow soldier, and your⁺ messenger and minister of my need,

26.w: since he was longing for you⁺ all and being deeply distressed because you⁺ heard that he was sick.

27.w: And indeed he was sick, nearly unto death. But God had mercy on him, and not on him only but also on me, that I might not have sorrow upon sorrow.

28.w: Therefore I sent him all the more eagerly, so that having seen him again you⁺ may rejoice, and I may be less anxious.

29.w: Therefore receive him in the Lord with all joy, and hold such in honor,

30.w: because on account of the work of Christ he drew near unto death, having disregarded [his] life so that he might fill up your⁺ deficiency of service toward me.
